description: Returns the DelegAIze agent catalogue (what each agent does, its tools, minutes saved per item), the clustering rules, the agents that match the input by keyword, and a personal link (demo or free start) carrying utm and ref/pc. Input: EITHER beschreibung (the user's description of their work or one pasted mail) OR mail_uebersicht (subjects + sender domains, optionally a count per line, that YOUR mail tools collected — no bodies, no full addresses). No sign-in, nothing is stored, no data leaves for third parties. You do the reasoning: cluster with the rules, then present processes, agents and the estimated hours per month.

beschreibung.description: Description of the work or one pasted mail (max 8000 chars).

mail_uebersicht.description: One entry per mail or per group of similar mails.

pc.description: Optional partner code from the user's link. Passed on to the sign-up/demo link.

ref.description: Optional person code from the link the user came with (e.g. th, km). Passed on to the sign-up/demo link.

tage.description: How many days the mail summary covers (for the per-month estimate). Default 30.

variante.description: Campaign entry: backoffice (default), sap, maschinenbau, partner, verain (clubs), coachaize (studios), tekta (structures). sachverstaendige returns the trial case file link instead.

name: agenten_check
title: Agent check (description or mail summary)
